This is the most quoted statistic in enterprise AI. What does the 95 per cent in the report count?

You have almost certainly heard this figure quoted at you in the past year. It comes from a July 2025 report by MIT's Project NANDA. The headline travelled further than the report did. Before we ask why AI value is not realised, we should establish whether this number says what people think. So consider the question on screen, and choose an answer. Take a moment.

The figure counts organisations, not pilots. Hold that distinction, because it changes the size of the problem considerably.
